scripts.sync:portfolio: node --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'fs'; import { portfolio } from './server/src/data/portfolio.js'; writeFileSync('netlify/functions/portfolio-data.json', JSON.stringify(portfolio, null, 2));"
scripts.build: npm run sync:portfolio && npm run build:client
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx netlify deploy --prod
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx netlify deploy
